title: Mains voltage: peak and period
caption: A 230 V rms supply swings between ±V₀ with V₀ = 230√2 = 325 V. At 50 Hz the period is T = 1/50 = 20 ms, so the voltage completes a full cycle every 20 ms and passes through zero twice in each. The rms value, 230 V, is lower than the peak because the voltage spends time near zero.
alt: Graph of mains voltage against time: a sine wave with peaks of ±325 V and a period of 20 ms.
description: The horizontal axis is time in milliseconds; the vertical axis is the voltage in volts.
The voltage is V₀ sin(2πft) with V₀ = 325 V and f = 50 Hz.
It peaks at 325 V at 5 ms, is zero again at 10 ms, reaches −325 V at 15 ms and finishes the cycle at 20 ms.
